newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Steady to buy 11.01 pct stake in Citra.
newsitem.headline: Steady to buy 11.01 pct stake in Citra.

text.p: Indonesian transportation company PT Steady Safe will buy an 11.01 percent stake in toll road operator PT Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada, newspapers reported on Friday.

Bisnis Indonesia and Harian Neraca Ekonomi newspapers quoted a statement from Steady Safe saying the firm would buy 110 million shares of Citra Marga from Purna Bhakti Pertiwi Foundation, one of Citra Marga's shareholders.
"The (proposed) deal will be subject to Bapepam's (Capital Market Supervisory Agency) and shareholders' approvals," Steady Safe was quoted as saying.
The company did not provide further details.
Ofiicials of Citra Marga and Steady Safe were not immediately available for comment.

Citra Marga is a toll road operator controlled by President Suharto's eldest daughter Siti Hardijanti Rukmana. Steady Safe, controlled by businessman Jopie Wijaya, operates city buses, taxis. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
